About this study +

Each side is a separate moving layer. The right inner edge can travel over a stationary left surface; it does not drag the left spring or its artwork.

Hidden edge padding uses nearby pixels from the original photo. The right layer stays in front when the edges overlap. This is a 2D depth illusion, with conservative travel limits.

This first layered proof needs visual and physical iPhone review. Sideways separation is restrained; the concealed backing is an approximation and can still show repeated texture. The original portrait is preserved unchanged and shown exactly at rest.
